Developer Platform · v1 Preview

One API to orchestrate
live creator challenges.

Sparked Live provides an AI-powered Challenge Management API that works ancillary to major live social networks including TikTok and Kick.com—standardizing challenge rules, real-time scoring, moderation, and webhooks.

Request API keyView core endpoints
Ancillary software architecture: Sparked Live integrates alongside TikTok and Kick.com through authorized webhooks, OAuth-scoped data, and creator-approved connectors. We never ask for platform passwords and do not represent or act on behalf of Kick.com or TikTok.
01 / Unified Model

Cross-network challenge schema

Define duration, milestone thresholds, participant rosters, and settlement criteria once—then run synchronized live challenges across TikTok and Kick.com streams.

02 / AI Verification

Automated event scoring & safety

AI pipelines parse stream events, score goal progress, flag duplicate or anomalous submissions, and generate concise creator & community recap summaries.

03 / Event-Driven

Real-time webhooks & overlays

Push verified state changes to OBS browser overlays, Discord bots, mobile apps, or creator dashboards via HMAC-signed HTTPS webhooks.

Core REST endpoints

Base URL: https://api.sparkedlive.com/v1 · Authentication: Bearer API key (Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...)

Sparked Live Challenge Management API v1 core endpoints
Method & EndpointPurposeSupported Networks
POST /v1/challengesCreate and configure a live challenge with timing, scoring rules, and AI moderation flags.TikTok, Kick.com, Multi-network
GET /v1/challenges/{id}Fetch current challenge metadata, active status, participant counts, and normalized metrics.TikTok, Kick.com
POST /v1/challenges/{id}/participantsEnroll authorized creator handles or community teams into an active challenge session.TikTok, Kick.com
POST /v1/challenges/{id}/eventsIngest live stream milestones and trigger AI validation against configured challenge rules.TikTok, Kick.com, Custom overlays
GET /v1/challenges/{id}/leaderboardReturn real-time ranked standings, verified progress percentages, and AI stream highlights.Cross-network unified
POST /v1/webhooksRegister signed callback URLs for challenge.started, milestone.verified, and challenge.completed.All events

Request & webhook examples

AI capabilities under the hood

  • Normalized telemetry across networks: Harmonizes disparate live engagement and challenge events from TikTok and Kick.com into a single schema.
  • AI rule verification & anomaly detection: Evaluates challenge milestones in near real time and flags inconsistent or abusive inputs before leaderboard updates.
  • Automated creator recaps: Summarizes challenge performance, peak moments, and audience participation for post-stream review.
  • Privacy-first authorization: Operates only on data explicitly authorized by creators or developers; disconnect or revoke API keys at any time.
